title: Two contact faces with a transfer pinion
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of C (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents agree. A positive, B positive. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. B positive, C negative. The requested motion is CCW (in listed output order).
